breaking.change: Text drawn in a host element other than <Text> is refused at mount: a dynamic string child of a <View>, <Scroll>, <Image>… throws `og.ui: the text "…" is a bare child of <view>: put it in a <Text>` (static text there was already a compile error). It is never wrapped for you.
breaking.fix: Put the text in a <Text>: `<View>{label}</View>` becomes `<View><Text>{label}</Text></View>`. A wrapper that spreads its props into a View (`<View {...props} />`) passes its children through, so its callers give it a <Text> child, not a string.

fixed.summary: A host element's spread (`<View {...props} />`) now puts the spread's `children` in the element when it has none of its own, as Solid does; before, they were dropped, so every built-in Button drew an empty plate with no label or icon.
